art_direction.theme: Palette rebuilt around the company logo: amber/gold as the leading accent and charcoal as the dark surface, with the requested blue and white retained as a full part of the system. Heavy lowercase display headings on white, full-bleed blue panels for the process and vision/mission, charcoal panels for footer and testimonials, amber for buttons, numerals, icon plates and rules.
art_direction.signature_element: Blueprint grid on dark and tinted panels; rising circle staircase for the development process; amber rules under headings.
art_direction.border_radius: Near-sharp (2-4px); circles only where the deck uses them

typography.treatment: Headings use the .display-heavy utility — extrabold, tight tracking (-0.03em), often lowercase to match the deck ('about us', 'vision', 'mission'). No serif, no italics.

backend: none — enquiry form opens a prefilled mailto: or WhatsApp message

pages.Home: hero, stats, about intro, marquee, all six services, development process, featured project, sectors, commitments, portfolio preview, testimonials, enquiry form
pages.About Us: split hero, story, service grid, vision & mission, turnkey model + four-stage detail, values, commitment panel
pages.Portfolio: filterable grid, case studies in a modal, capabilities, regional reach
pages.Contact Us: enquiry form, WhatsApp/phone CTAs, map, contact details

color_rules: Amber is the primary accent: buttons, large numerals, icon plates, rules, dark-panel highlights.
Buttons on amber use ink (#141A24) text — amber with white text fails contrast.
Blue stays the link/small-text accent on white (6.3:1) and carries the full-bleed process and vision/mission panels.
Charcoal #1C2431 is both the heading colour and the dark surface, matching the logo's lettering.
